title: Review of c41's CIPS parasite negative on fresh seed 4: replicated; the slow parasite settles in 12/12 bodies as a passenger, prey stop dividing (12 -> 11 vs 12 -> 19 in the twin), no free predator spots
summary: labkit rerun of world_base.py on seed 4 (rerun/seed4, t=10000) and the finding's pred.py on the same seed: checkpoint at t=8000, then the slow-kinetics arm (kp 0.02, kd 0.003, Dc 0.05, chic 3, order 1, c0 0.02) and the matched c-free twin (kp 0) for 10400 t. Parasite arm: predator spots equal the prey count within 650 t (12/12) and stay with them; prey 12 -> 11 by t=18400 and bodies shrink to small dots (pred_s4_pred.png). Twin: c decays to 0 and prey 12 -> 19. No predator spot ever exists outside a body.

observations.F: pred_s4_pred.json: (t, prey, predator spots) 8650: 12/12, 13250: 12/12, 18400: 11/11; pred_s4_twin.json: prey 12 -> 19, c 0; pred_s4_pred.png: every body carries c and shrinks

controls_run.F: pred_s4_twin (kp 0 from the same t=8000 checkpoint)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and only the slow-kinetics setting; the branch ran 10400 t (pred.py's TA is a duration). Spots are counted at c>0.3 with >= 20 px, as in pred.py.
